Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Surendra Kumar Tripathi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajesh Dutta Pandey Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been preferred by the applicants with a prayer to quash the charge-sheet dated 18.01.2023, cognizance as well as summoning order dated 25.04.2023 and proceedings of Case No. 193/IX/2023 (State Vs. Shishupal Singh and others)
arising out of Case Crime No. 828 of 2022, under Sections 323, 354, 504, 506, 498A I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Highway, District Mathura, pending in the court of Civil Judge (Junior Division), Fast Track Court (Crime Against Women) Judicial Magistrate,
Mathura.

sentences.text: On the matter being taken up, Mr. Surendra Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants do not want to press this application, therefore, they may be permitted to withdraw the same.
Learned Additional Government Advocate for the State as well as learned counsel for opposite party No. 2 have no objection to such prayer of the applicants.
In view of the statement made by learned counsel for the applicants at the Bar, the instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as not pressed / withdrawn.
